verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Pulumi's CLI supports fully non-interactive plan/apply cycles in CI (`pulumi preview --non-interactive --json`, `pulumi up --non-interactive --yes --skip-preview`), satisfying the core CI automation and approval-flag requirement. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation or proof of Pulumi's saved 'update plan' artifact workflow (e.g., --save-plan/--plan flags) being used across separate plan/apply steps, so the specific 'saved plan artifact' pattern is unverified.
